info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Mortgage Loans Documents-v5-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Documents Retrieval API provides access to a comprehensive list of documents associated with mortgage loans. This endpoint allows users to efficiently retrieve important documentation required for processing loan applications and managing existing accounts. Typical consumers include financial institutions, mortgage brokers, and loan officers who need to access loan documentation as part of their workflow. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their document management processes, ensuring they have the necessary information at their fingertips.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all relevant documents associated with loans. Use this to gather information and documentation required for loan processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve loan document information. It requires specific parameters defined in the request schema, which detail the required and optional attributes needed for the query. Please ensure that all necessary fields are included to successfully retrieve the correct loan documents.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of loan documents.
